offline.center.title: Sync
offline.center.subtitle: What this device captured offline, and what is still waiting to be sent.
offline.center.nothing: Nothing waiting: everything captured on this device has been sent.
offline.center.blockedHelp: These items need fixing: the server refused them on their merits, not because of a dropped connection. Correct the entry or remove the item.
offline.center.waitingHelp: These items refer to something created offline that has not reached the server yet. They will go out on their own once it does.
offline.center.snapshots: Reference data held on this device
offline.center.snapshotsHelp: An encrypted local copy, refreshed whenever you are online. It is what lets you work without a network; it never stands in for a fresh read.
offline.center.discardConfirm: Remove this item for good? What was captured will be lost.
offline.center.limitsBody: Posting an entry, issuing a numbered invoice, taking a payment, filing a return and closing a financial year each carry a legal number or an outside effect. They cannot be replayed from a device: the application refuses them offline rather than queueing them.
offline.unavailableBody: This screen needs the server. It will open again when the network is back.
offline.partners.fromSnapshot: Offline: list from the local copy, and it may be incomplete.
